output.source_text: Applying C Whole Tone Scale over a C7 shell voicing (LH: C, E, Bb). The scale provides altered chord tones / tensions flat 5th (F#/Gb) and sharp 5th / flat 13th (G#/Ab), making it ideal over Dom7#5 chords (e.g. C7#5).

note_vi: Bài 21 của nguồn Jazz Scales (YouTube), mốc 04:10-04:48. Applying C Whole Tone Scale over a C7 shell voicing (LH: C, E, Bb). The scale provides altered chord tones / tensions flat 5th (F#/Gb) and sharp 5th / flat 13th (G#/Ab), making it ideal over Dom7#5 chords (e.g. C7#5).
